Q9029.reason: Hypotonic water absorbed across bladder mucosa can cause fluid and electrolyte imbalance, which is why 0.9% saline is used for washout; bypass or failure is not specific to water.

Q9030.reason: Under Restatement (Second) § 311 the parties may modify a third-party beneficiary contract before the beneficiary assents, sues, or relies, and the son learned of the contract only after payment.

Q9031.reason: A general anti-assignment clause does not bar assignment of a right to payment; UCC 2-210, 9-406, and Restatement § 322 make that restriction ineffective, so C and D misstate the law.
